La impugnación quedó contenida en un voluminoso documento de 639 páginas y un anexo de 49... el 30 de agosto el tribunal electoral desestimó los recursos presentados por el PRD por \"infundados\" y declaró \"jurídicamente improcedente\" el pedido de anulación","locator":"extracted HTML block 50","attribution":"BOOK-013","period_fit":"2012 electoral protest period. López Obrador was opposition candidate, not president. TEPJF ruling is a legal fact. López Obrador used this context to justify his 2018 platform","claim_type":"observed_fact","polarity":"adverse","actor":"Peña Nieto (government of Mexico)","action":"governed Mexico during period of violence (200,000+ killed), economic deterioration (inflation, price increases for essentials), and corruption scandals","mechanism":"inherited governance context presented as background for López Obrador's platform","outcome":"shock context of violence, macroeconomic stress, and corruption cited as justification for 2018 campaign platform commitments","dates":["2006-2018"],"quantities":["200,000+ killed since 2006","several thousand missing/displaced"],"excerpt":"Desde 2006, 200.000 personas habían sido asesinadas ya y varias miles más se encontraban desaparecidas o desplazadas, escalofriante estadística propia de un país en guerra civil. Peña Nieto era embestido también por la subida de la inflación y el encarecimiento de la canasta básica. La ciudadanía estaba irritada por las alzas de los precios de los combustibles y la electricidad, dos suministros esenciales que la reforma energética de 2013, supuestamente, venía a abaratar. Y sin olvidar los escándalos de corrupción que sacudían al priísmo y minaban su credibilidad.","locator":"extracted HTML block 58","attribution":"BOOK-013","period_fit":"Peña Nieto administration context (2006-2018); this is background condition inherited by López Obrador, not evidence of his own governance.","source_limitations":["Context about EPN administration, not López Obrador's own record. Source is López Obrador's biography framing EPN's record negatively. Independent verification needed for casualty figures and economic data."],"question_ids":["5B.9","5B.10"],"verification_status":"accepted","verification_notes":["All elements accurately sourced from block 58. The causal attribution to the 2013 energy reform for price rises uses \"supuestivamente\" (supposedly) in source, which the claim correctly conveys through \"attributed to.\" Observed_fact is appropriate label as the source presents these as reported conditions, not López Obrador's own claims."],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0010","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"López Obrador registered as precandidate on December 12, 2017 and formally as candidate on March 16, 2018, with a platform centered on 'Cuarta Transformación,' peaceful democratic transition, anti-corruption, justice without vengeance, rule of law, and no revenge or persecution against political opponents","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"context","actor":"López Obrador","action":"registered presidential candidacy with platform of Fourth Transformation, peaceful change, honest government, anti-corruption, justice without vengeance, rule of law","mechanism":"stated governance framework during candidacy/transition","outcome":"peaceful democratic transformation agenda with anti-corruption commitment and explicit non-retaliation pledge","dates":["December 12, 2017","March 16, 2018"],"quantities":[],"excerpt":"\"Cuarta Transformación\", transformación que iban a lograr \"sin violencia, de manera pacífica, con información y orientación, con la difusión de principios éticos, liberando a nuestros conciudadanos del miedo y la desinformación... un gobierno honesto que represente a todos\", \"el renacimiento económico, social, político y, sobre todo, moral de nuestro querido México\", y \"un auténtico Estado democrático de derecho\". Ellos no compartían la máxima de \"ni perdón ni olvido\": un Gobierno de MORENA acabaría certainly con \"la corrupción, la impunidad y los lujos en el Gobierno\", pero los \"integrantes del poder económico y político\" del país debían de saber que \"no les guardamos rencor y les aseguramos que tras su posible derrota no habrá represalias, ni persecución, ni destierro para nadie\". \"Declaramos enfáticamente que lo que se necesita es justicia, no venganza, no odiamos a nadie\"","locator":"extracted HTML block 61","attribution":"BOOK-013","period_fit":"2017-2018 campaign and transition; presidency begins December 1, 2018. The quote \"lo que se necesita es justicia, no venganza, no odiamos a nadie\" is verbatim from source. The non-retaliation commitment is accurately captured. Minor: \"rule of law\" is inferred from \"un auténtico Estado democrático de derecho\" rather than explicit, but reasonably supported."],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0011","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"López Obrador's 2018 platform committed to 'republican austerity' (austeridad republicana): no tax increases, no new debt issuance, gradual minimum wage increase to 171 pesos by end of sexenio, monthly pensions of 1,500 pesos for seniors, increased domestic gasoline production to reduce imports and prices, energy and food self-sufficiency with agricultural price guarantees, and reversal of Peña Nieto's energy reform","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"context","actor":"López Obrador","action":"committed to fiscal austerity without tax/debt increases, wage/pension increases, domestic production focus, energy self-sufficiency, and energy reform reversal","mechanism":"stated 2018 fiscal and economic policy platform","outcome":"budget reorientation without new taxes or debt; quantified wage/pension targets; import reduction through domestic production","dates":["2018"],"quantities":["171 pesos (minimum wage target end of sexenio)","1,500 pesos monthly (pension target)"],"excerpt":"\"austeridad republicana\", un ajuste fiscal ligado al ahorro de gastos corrientes del Estado y la reorientación de los recursos públicos a la inversión, sin subir ningún impuesto (y sí bajando algunos, pero sólo en los estados fronterizos con Estados Unidos) y sin emitir deuda. Habría un aumento gradual del salario mínimo, hasta los 171 pesos al final del sexenio, y lo mismo para las pensiones de adultos mayores, que cobrarían mensualidades de 1.500 pesos. Se incrementaría la oferta de gasolina autóctona para reducir las importaciones y rebajar los precios... La reforma energética de Peña Nieto sería sometida a una revisión a fondo, anulando y revirtiendo cuanto fuera necesario.
